message: The brainstorm gate revised a clarify-gate answer. Clarify put FR-9 gutter content in the Notes tab; brainstorm found FR-28 already fills that tab with AnnotationRows, so every annotation would render twice and leader lines would cross composables. Revised to an in-stage right-edge gutter. Recording it as a REVISION rather than letting the two artifacts silently disagree - clarify.json survey[] still carries the superseded answer, and Stage 5 must read brainstorm as the later decision. Also recorded: AC-5 and AC-7 carry verificationMethod=test from the PRD, but this repo has zero Compose UI tests among 160 green, so they will be satisfied by pure plus reducer tests plus a preview rather than by the rendered assertion the method implies. That is a verification-method mismatch inherited from upstream, not a shortcut taken here.

SECOND occurrence: the refine agent reported writing proposedSurvey into data.survey but the payload shipped with zero entries, so the gate decisions existed only in its message. Same defect on F-2, where I caught it the same way and patched manually. It is a real pattern worth fixing in the agent definition rather than in each run - the orchestrator should keep verifying survey length after every refine wrap. Carried to the batched retrospective.
First decompose attempt terminated on an API error (connection lost mid-response), not on a task failure. No payload was written. Retrying with the same brief.

B2 reported two things worth keeping. (1) The Skiko probe FAILED - ImageBitmap(2,3) throws LibraryLoadException in presentation-feature-mirror desktopTest because only compose-application wires compose.desktop.currentOs, and AS-14 forbids adding it. Rather than dropping AC-47 to inspection+demo, the agent noticed ImageBitmap is a plain interface and built FakeFrameBitmap in commonTest, so AC-47 keeps a real automated assertion on frame identity plus both dimensions. Strictly better than the planned fallback. (2) T-3 TAC-4 was unachievable as written: it asked that all six MirrorIntent cases compile with no handler wired, but handleIntent when(intent) is also exhaustive with no else, so the cases cannot compile without handlers. T-4 was in the same batch so handlers landed immediately; a lone T-3 would have needed six placeholder branches. Reported rather than quietly satisfied.

CommentPopover.kt:68-70 declares three hardcoded Color(0xFF...) values (PopoverInk, PopoverMetaInk, PopoverMeasureInk), a direct violation of design-tokens.md which forbids literal Color at any call site. VERIFIED PRE-EXISTING: git diff development..HEAD shows this spec added none of them; they date from the original kit commit. This spec did extend that file (T-8 added focusRequester and closeLabel), so the violation is now adjacent to our work without being ours. Not fixed here - out of scope and a kit-wide restyle question - but routed to Stage 5 so it is adjudicated rather than inherited silently. Note the irony that StyleguideScreen.kt:868 lists Hardcoded Color(0x) in the kit as a negative rule in its own guidance.
